research_rationale: The full two-page official EO 12075 extract establishes an indefinite interagency council and twelve operative provisions; source-generator boilerplate, headings and page furniture in the machine draft have been removed, and merged 1-202/1-203 and 1-301/1-302 provisions split. No clause has a sunset, deadline, report-triggered expiry, or separate completed repeal. Section 1-304 is a continuing report duty, not a termination trigger. The actual earlier source EO 12148 section 5-210 adds FEMA to the open-ended membership in 1-102; it neither substitutes the existing roster nor ends an original command. Section 6 expressly makes that addition effective July 15, 1979, rather than July 20 signature or July 24 publication. Its emergency-function savings in 2-302 are confined to section 1 transfers, not this Council membership amendment. The complete EO 12379 section 14 then revokes EO 12075 as amended, with immediate wording and August 17, 1982 signature and no delayed effectiveness or savings. Generic inactivity in the cleanup preamble does not legally terminate these indefinite authorities; no actual earlier contrary instrument is identified in the bounded OFR/saved-text searches. The two current-law hits are historical notes for the membership amendment and revocation, not continuing predicates. Original 1-205 reserves pre-existing EOP procedures and supplies no independently surviving directive. On that target-specific chronology, August 17, 1982 is the first supported legal end of all original commands and the whole order. This is a producer conclusion for independent review, not a human certification; the USC search limitation to October 9 remains explicit and is complemented by the cutoff eCFR and later-EO scopes.

savings_residuals.reason: Within the complete original, the actual amending order and revoker, and the accepted numbered-EO/current-law search scopes, no continuing independent EO 12075 command or express saving is identified. Original 1-205 limits Council action so it does not replace EOP clearance, review and decisionmaking; it does not create a new independent EOP authority. Original 1-301 to 1-304 cooperation, support, working groups and reporting serve this Council and have no separate post-termination direction. EO 12148 section 2-302 preserves only functions transferred by that order section 1; adding FEMA to this Council under 5-210 is not such a transfer. EO 12379 revokes EO 12075 as amended without reservation. Historical administrative acts and independently existing EOP procedures are not treated as continued Council commands.

quoted_parts:
